data.name: Peter
data.gender_notes: Peter is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Petah' meaning 'rock'. In the New Testament, St. Peter was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ and is considered the first pope by the Catholic Church. He was a fisherman by trade and is famously known for walking on water when Jesus called him to join Him. The name Peter carries the meaning “Rock, Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Peter usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes firmness, stability, and faith in God.
data.etymology: Peter belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rock, Stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Peter total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: פטר
in_hebrew.meaning: בן אלוהים, האבן היסודית של הכנסייה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פטר הוא שם שמקורו בעברית ונגזר מהמילה 'פטר' שפירושה 'אבן' או 'סלע'. זהו שם שמשמעותו אבן היסוד או הסלע עליו בנויה הכנסייה, כפי שנאמר במתיא 16:18. השם פטר הוא אחד משמות התלמידים הקרובים לישו, והוא היה אחד משנים עשר השליחים הראשונים.

in_greek.name: Πέτρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Πέτρος είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του ονόματος 'פטר', που σημαίνει 'πέτρα' ή 'σκληρή πέτρα'. Στο Ευαγγέλιο του Μαθηαίου 16:18, ο Ιησούς Χριστός δίνει στον Πέτρο το όνομα 'Πέτρα' ως σύμβολο της αποστολής του ως θεμέλιον της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Petrus
in_latin.meaning: rock, stone, or foundation of the Church
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Petrus is derived from the Greek 'Πέτρος', meaning 'rock' or 'stone'. In Christian tradition, Saint Peter, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, was given this name by Christ, signifying his role as the foundation of the Church, as recorded in Matthew 16:18.

in_english.name: Peter
in_english.meaning: rock or stone, symbolizing strength and stability
in_english.long_meaning: The name Peter originates from the Hebrew 'פטר' (Petra) and Greek 'Πέτρος' (Petros), meaning 'rock' or 'stone'. In Christian tradition, Saint Peter, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, was given this name by Christ, signifying his role as the foundation of the Church. The name symbolizes strength, stability, and leadership, reflecting Peter's significant role in early Christian history.

data.cultural_impact: Peter is one of the most well-known figures in Christian history. He played a crucial role as a leader and founder of the early Christian church. The name Peter has been passed down through generations and is common among Christian communities around the world. It's also associated with strength, steadfastness, and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, St. Peter holds a special place as a disciple of Jesus, and his name is deeply symbolic. Peter represents faith and trust in God, as evidenced by his ability to walk on water when he had faith in Jesus. The name Peter also symbolizes the rock upon which the Church was built, as Jesus said to Peter, "You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church" (Matthew 16:18). This name is a reminder of the solid foundation of faith that Christians strive to build in their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Peter, from the Greek Petros, meaning 'rock', symbolizes steadfastness and strength in faith. As the first disciple called by Jesus, he represents the foundation of the church upon which Christ builds His community.
